payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute prefix/suffix ORs; apply all k multiplications to each element, compute OR, take max; justified by greedy exchange argument that concentrating operations on one element is optimal.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a greedy exchange argument: multiplying one number by x^k yields the best OR because OR is bitwise monotonic and splitting operations cannot set higher bits than concentrating them. Then it simply tries each element.
